title_original: 2028 Venice Biennale: Hoor Al Qasimi appointed curator

blocks.text: A news item by ArtThrob Editors on the 26th of November 2026. This should take you 2 minutes to read.
The 62nd International Art Exhibition will take place from 8 April to 26 November 2028.

The Board of La Biennale di Venezia met on 20 November, and, upon the recommendation of President Pietrangelo Buttafuoco, appointed Hoor Al Qasimi as Director of the Visual Arts Department, with the specific task of curating the 62 nd International Art Exhibition to be held in 2028.

Hoor Al Qasimi is a curator and leading figure in the international art scene. Since 2009, she has led the Sharjah Art Foundation, which she founded with the aim of promoting knowledge of contemporary art and fostering cultural exchange in Sharjah, the United Arab Emirates and internationally.

“La Biennale di Venezia is a place where the world converges with art through its diverse visions. Throughout her career, Hoor Al Qasimi has succeeded in creating a caravanserai of geographies and the Universal, giving voice to stories and sensibilities shaped by research and the unexpected. Her work brings together a profound attentiveness to deep-rooted memory and its legacies, an open perspective on the intricate complexities of the present, and a rare ability to listen to places and their people. I also recognise in her a quality of balance and composure, namely the vibrant presence of mīzān (inner harmony), which finds its strength in relationships. These are qualities that we feel are particularly close to La Biennale’s vision. We entrust her with the 62 nd International Art Exhibition with great confidence and with the curiosity to discover the treasure trove of living knowledge that she will bring to Venice.”

“The International Art Exhibition of La Biennale di Venezia has been an important platform for many of us around the world. I first visited the 50th edition in 2003 having recently stepped into my curatorial role at Sharjah Biennial. For me, La Biennale continues to be a critical space to engage with the work of influential artists and curators. I am honoured to have been invited to curate this exhibition and grateful to President, Pietrangelo Buttafuoco, and the board for their confidence and trust. I look forward to working with the team of La Biennale and welcoming audiences to the 62nd edition.”

Hoor Al Qasimi is President and Director of Sharjah Art Foundation, the public art institution she founded in 2009 as a catalyst for contemporary art and cultural exchange in Sharjah, the UAE and internationally. Director of Sharjah Biennial since 2003, she has curated and co-curated major exhibitions for the Foundation and numerous international institutions, including the acclaimed Sharjah Biennial 15 (2023), the international travelling retrospective of Hassan Sharif (2017–2018) and solo exhibitions of Jorge Tacla (2026), Leda Catunda (2025), Bouchra Khalili (2024), Emily Karaka (2024), William Kentridge (2024), Monir Shahroudy Farmanfarmaian (2019), Rasheed Araeen (2014), Simone Fattal (2016), Farideh Lashai (2016) and Yayoi Kusama (2016–2017). Al Qasimi also serves as President of the International Biennial Association; President of Sharjah Museums Authority; President of The Africa Institute, Sharjah; President and Director of the Sharjah Architecture Triennial; President of Sharjah’s Global Studies University; President of the Sharjah Creative Quarter; and President of the University of the Arts Sharjah. Al Qasimi curated the second Lahore Biennial (2020), was Artistic Director of the sixth Aichi Triennale, titled A Time Between Ashes and Roses (2025), as well as the 25th Biennale of Sydney, titled Rememory (2026). She received the insignia of Officier de l’Ordre des Arts et des Lettres, conferred by the Embassy of France in the UAE. She is the 2025–2026 Ambassador Extraordinary for Arab Culture by ALECSO.
